keyword: are taxes due at the end of april 15
claims: Tax Day is not always April 15.
April 15 is the standard deadline for federal income tax returns in the U.S.
The Tax Day deadline moves to the next business day if April 15 falls on a weekend (Saturday or Sunday) or a holiday such as Emancipation Day in Washington, D.C.
If April 15 is a Saturday, Sunday, or holiday, the Tax Day deadline moves to Monday or the next business day.
Taxpayers can file for an extension using Form 4868 to move their filing deadline to October 15.
Taxes owed must still be paid by the April deadline.
April 15 became the standard date in 1955.
March dates were used for the Tax Day deadline in earlier years.
The IRS may extend deadlines for residents in federally declared disaster areas.
For 2026, Tax Day is Wednesday, April 15, according to official IRS guidance.
